text:
matt: kicking off the change window in ~30m (23:00 UTC). need a tight sync across api, runtime, console, router. plan below, pls ack + any blocking deps.
priya: ack, will own API pin + canary routing. i’ll update release notes link when ready.
jordan: ack, runtime team on-call monitoring. runtime will land kernel v2.4-q8 and quant profile q8-fast.
kim: console ready for db-migration toggle, won't be user-visible until final step. will keep the feature flag closed until 75% traffic.
sam: router will apply staged traffic-shift rules — 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 30m. we need to pin fallback to r-2024-08 in case of errors.
matt: rollout sequence: 1) deploy API v1.9.0 canary (5%) 2) deploy runtime kernel v2.4-q8 to canary nodes 3) router stage 5% 4) console minor release 3.1.0 to canaries 5) metrics check 10m 6) increase to 25% -> 100% if green.
deploy-bot: Deploy job started: job_id=deploy-2245001234-1; targets=[api:v1.9.0, runtime:v2.4-q8, console:3.1.0, router:r-2024-09]; canary_percent=5%.
priya: added note — API has a schema change in /v1/generate responses (adds new field "meta.source"). console will ignore unknown fields; please validate SDK compatibility.
jordan: runtime note: kv-cache TTL bumped to 60s for canary to reduce cold starts. watch memory churn on canaries.
kim: console migration plan: toggle migration_flag=false -> deploy console -> smoke -> set migration_flag=true at 75%. will post the toggle commands in ops-runbook.
sam: router staging commands (will run at step 3):
```
# set router canary
routerctl apply --policy canary --percent 5 --pin-fallback r-2024-08
# later: routerctl promote --percent 25
```
matt: acceptance checks (auto): 1) 5xx rate < 0.5% over 10m 2) p95 latency not increase >20% 3) error budget burn < threshold 4) no auth regressions in /v1/generate. manual rollback criteria: sustained 5xx >1% for 10m or p95 > 2x baseline.
oncall-bot: Alerting hooks validated: lux-db, api-5xx, runtime-mem, router-loss. Team: will page on breach.
priya: release notes draft: https://internal.redwood/release/2245001234 — added API change log and SDK warnings.
jordan: telemetry dashboard link: https://grafana.redwood/d/ops/deploy-2245001234 — watch runtime_kv_hits and mem_rss.
matt: testers: please run smoke for generate + embeddings on canary endpoints. quick commands: `curl -X POST https://canary.api.redwood/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'`
sam: if we need immediate rollback, router fallback is pinned. rollback steps summarized: 1) routerctl promote --percent 0 && routerctl set-default r-2024-08 2) api pin to v1.8.7: `kubectl set image deploy/api api=redwood/api:v1.8.7` 3) runtime revert kernel using canary rollback job 4) console toggle migration_flag=false.
kim: noted. i'll keep console flag action ready.
priya: :thumbsup: rolling canary now. will update thread with canary health and release-notes final link.
deploy-bot: Canary update: api.v1.9.0 rolled to 5% -> pods=12 -> ready=12 -> checks=passed.
matt: great — keeping 10m observation window before next ramp. will call the 25% ramp in this thread.
priya: quick FYI: SDK team warned some clients may parse ints as strings for new meta field; added compatibility shim in client lib.
jordan: observing slight mem jitter on 2 nodes (runtime.canary-3, runtime.canary-7). mem delta ~12% — keeping an eye.
oncall-bot: paging rule armed: will page if 5xx > 0.8% for 5m.
matt: decision log: if jitter persists and causes >1% 5xx, we stop ramp and roll runtime back. otherwise proceed.
sam: ready to run promote at +10m if green.
priya: final release notes published: https://internal.redwood/release/2245001234/final. tagging release in repo: git tag release/2245001234.
matt: thanks all. will post post-deploy notes after 24h stability window. good work.
